flag_radius_unit_note: 100 miles in km, the conventional Acc@161 km tolerance in user geolocation (Han et al. 2014).
why_not_in_the_manifests: The two runs of 2026-06-01 predate the flag_radius_km request parameter and the manifest field that records it (src/geolens/manifest.py), both added after 0.8.0 and released in 0.14.1 (see CHANGELOG.md). At the evaluation tag the radius was not a setting: the flag compared the consensus distance against a module constant.

source_at_tag.constant_unchanged_since: 0.7.0 (2026-05-27); the value has not changed in any later version
source_at_tag.caveat: Both runs finished before the evaluated code was committed in the development repository (2026-06-01T18:03:18Z), and no file records the exact tree they ran on. The constant is 161.0 in every development commit from 0.7.0 to that commit, and no override existed, so the radius cannot have been anything else unless the working tree was edited by hand.
